# KnowledgeDigest

KnowledgeDigest is a Python document-indexing and SQLite FTS5 search application. The local path extracts user-selected files, stores chunks and metadata in the configured SQLite database, and supports BM25-ranked full-text search through CLI, Python API, desktop GUI, and web viewer.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/knowledgedigest
License of project source: MIT (LICENSE)
Version remains 0.4.0; no release is implied by this documentation update.

## Data flow and boundaries

- Local parsing, indexing, and ordinary FTS5 search use the configured local SQLite database; no LLM provider is required for them.
- CLI summarize uses Anthropic by default; summarize --flash selects Google GenAI. Selected chunks and prompts are sent to the configured provider when this command runs.
- The Python Summarizer API also supports Ollama or a custom base URL. A custom endpoint may be remote.
- Optional BACH import reads its configured SQLite database read-only and writes imported content to the KnowledgeDigest database.
- Optional SQLite Transit synchronization can transfer configured snapshots between nodes.
- The current web viewer binds to 127.0.0.1, uses HTTP without TLS, and is not an authenticated remote service.
- The desktop GUI currently has German-only visible strings and no language selector.

## Useful files

- README.md and README_de.md: user documentation and navigation.
- ARCHITECTURE.md: module, configuration, and data-flow notes.
- SECURITY.md: vulnerability reporting guidance and bounded source notes.
- THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md: manually maintained direct-dependency notes; not a generated SBOM or full transitive inventory.
- NOTICE and LICENSE: project attribution and project-source license.
- tests/test_metadata.py: metadata and navigation-anchor checks.
- tests/test_packaging.py: package-data contract check.
- tests/package_smoke.py: installed-artifact Qt icon smoke check; the packaging workflow separately runs the installed CLI with `--help`.
- tests/test_no_agpl.py: source guard against selected explicit PyMuPDF import names; not a distribution-license audit.
- .github/workflows/tests.yml: test matrix and wheel/sdist packaging smoke job.

## Configuration

Configuration filename is knowledgedigest.json. Lookup order is current working directory, package data/, Windows APPDATA/KnowledgeDigest/ when available, then XDG_CONFIG_HOME/knowledgedigest/ or ~/.config/knowledgedigest/. If none exists, built-in defaults are used with package data/ paths. An installed package directory may not be writable. There is no --config CLI option; Python callers can use get_config(Path(...)).

## Related tools

- NoteSpaceLLM: separate local SQLite/plain-text notebook for notes; no runtime integration is claimed (https://github.com/file-bricks/NoteSpaceLLM).
- BACH: optional read-only SQLite import path when configured (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bach).
- SQLite Transit Sync: optional snapshot synchronization adapter (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/sqlite-transit-sync).
- open-bricks: broader project family (https://github.com/open-bricks).

## Validation limits

Test and package checks cover selected behavior only. They are not a complete security review, license audit, generated SBOM, or deployment assessment. Optional provider and sync behavior depends on user configuration.
